name: Polskie Frame Window Counter
description: Authentic 1:1 replica of NaN GD's Frame Window Counter in Pusab font (bigFont.fnt). Pinned strictly to the top-left screen corner. Features 99.9% accurate physics, in-world click rings, rolling CPS & swift click detection for fast spam, exact millisecond timing, mini gamemodes & 2.2 gravity triggers, CBF detection with 'CBF: X (Frame Perfect!)' flashes, Ring FP counters, NaN GD sounds, and universal multi-stage binary & macro decoder for Eclipse Menu (.gdr2), MegaHack (.mhr binary & JSON), xdBot, xBot, TASBot, and JSON.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable or disable the Polskie Frame Window Counter overlay

overlay-scale.name: Overlay Scale
overlay-scale.description: Scale of the on-screen overlay in Pusab font

overlay-opacity.name: Overlay Background Opacity
overlay-opacity.description: Background opacity (0 = 100% transparent like NaN GD, 255 = solid black)

overlay-position.name: Overlay Position
overlay-position.description: Screen corner position for the overlay (default: top-left)

show-title.name: Show Title Header
show-title.description: Show the 'POLSKIE FWC' header title above the counter. Set to false for the clean 1:1 NaN GD look.

fp-sound-enabled.name: Frame Perfect Sound
fp-sound-enabled.description: Play chime/ding sound when hitting a 0-1f frame perfect window (NaN GD style)

fp-sound-type.name: Sound Type
fp-sound-type.description: Type of sound effect to play on Frame Perfect

show-cbf.name: Show CBF Indicator
show-cbf.description: Display CBF (Click Before Frame) count. Shows 'CBF: X (Frame Perfect!)' upon hitting FP

show-ring-fp.name: Show Ring / Orb FP
show-ring-fp.description: Detect and count orbs/rings hit within a Frame Perfect window

show-bucket-ms.name: Show Bucket Milliseconds
show-bucket-ms.description: Display millisecond duration on each frame window bucket (e.g. 1-2: 0 (8.33ms), 0-1: 0 (4.17ms))

show-last-ms.name: Show Last Click MS Timing
show-last-ms.description: Real-time indicator showing the exact millisecond timing of your last click (e.g. FP: 1f (4.17ms)! or LAST: 2f (8.33ms))

show-cps.name: Show Fast Spam & CPS
show-cps.description: Real-time Clicks Per Second (CPS) counter and peak CPS tracker for high-speed spam and swift clicks

show-gravity-mini.name: Show Mini & Gravity Indicator
show-gravity-mini.description: Display mini vehicle state and active 2.2 gravity multiplier / direction (e.g. MODE: MINI WAVE | GRAV: FLIPPED (1.5x))

show-ms-hz.name: Show MS & Hz
show-ms-hz.description: Show the latest input window in milliseconds and equivalent frequency

show-click-rings.name: In-World Click Rings
show-click-rings.description: Show temporary colored world-space rings for press and release inputs

show-gamemode.name: Show Gamemode
show-gamemode.description: Display current player gamemode (Cube, Wave, Ship, Robot, Spider, Ball, UFO, Swing)

show-higher-windows.name: Show Higher Windows (9-10)
show-higher-windows.description: Enable or disable showing higher frame windows. Disable to view only the tightest clicks (0-8f)

show-10plus-only.name: Show 10+ Overflow Bucket
show-10plus-only.description: Show or hide the highest 10+ overflow bucket (default false for 1:1 NaN GD)

macro-analysis-mode.name: Macro Analysis Mode
macro-analysis-mode.description: Analyze supported replay and macro event streams immediately after import
